2608.10729.title: Optimal Stopping of Self-Refining Foundation Models
2608.10729.paper_summary: Foundation models can improve their outputs through a self-refinement process driven by external feedback. In this process, the model is embedded in an iterative loop where it generates outputs, receives feedback from verifiers, and refines its responses through in-context learning. Following a novel approach, we formalize this process as an optimal stopping problem where the number of refinement iterations is decided based on expected improvement relative to cost. We derive optimal stopping policies and show that they can be efficiently computed through stochastic approximation. To evaluate our approach experimentally, we apply it to a coding benchmark for foundation models. The empirical results show that our stopping policies are significantly more cost-efficient than stopping policies proposed in prior work.
2608.10729.paper_summary_zh: 基礎模型可以通過外部反饋驅動的自我精煉過程來改善其輸出。<lb/>在這個過程中，模型嵌入在一個迭代循環中，生成輸出，從驗證者那裡獲得反饋，並通過上下文學習來精煉其回應。<lb/>根據一種新穎的方法，我們將這個過程形式化為一個最佳停止問題，其中精煉迭代的次數是根據相對於成本的預期改進來決定的。<lb/>我們推導出最佳停止策略，並顯示這些策略可以通過隨機近似有效計算。<lb/>為了在實驗上評估我們的方法，我們將其應用於基礎模型的編碼基準。<lb/>實證結果顯示，我們的停止策略在成本效率上顯著優於先前工作的停止策略。
